reason.generation1Result: K1 and K2 passed every validation-quality check and every exported-network check, but both failed the float-versus-quantized health check.
reason.rootCause: The original --float-checkpoint is the unconstrained optimizer shadow used by straight-through quantization-aware training. QAT forward and deployment use projected quantized parameters, so the raw shadow is not a deployment-equivalent float representation.

generation2DataPolicy.trainingCorpus: fresh target-blind sample, fresh orbit-disjoint teacher suite, and fresh teacher labels
generation2DataPolicy.forbiddenRootPolicy: Exclude every generation-1 source corpus, teacher suite, teacher result, residual corpus, training artifact, screen, confirmation, and match artifact discoverable before the generation-2 freeze.
generation2DataPolicy.matchPolicy: After one-time offline promotion, create fresh paired screen and confirmation suites that are orbit-disjoint from both generations' training, validation, test, and prior match positions.

unchangedContracts.candidateRecipes: K0, K1, and K2 use the exact original seeds, epochs, learning rates, and K1/K2 feature-transformer scales on the fresh generation-2 corpus.
unchangedContracts.splitRouting: The original deterministic groupId split algorithm and amendment 001 cross-phase clustering remain unchanged; the actual groups and rows are fresh.
unchangedContracts.selectionThresholds: All validation and health limits remain unchanged.
unchangedContracts.offlineThresholds: All point-estimate, phase, robustness, and bootstrap limits remain unchanged.
unchangedContracts.productionArtifact: The exported quantized NNUE remains the only engine runtime model.

amendedContracts.optimizerShadowCheckpoint: Preserve the lossless float optimizer shadow and its original quantization-penalty report under explicit optimizer-shadow artifact names.
amendedContracts.deploymentFloatCheckpoint: The planned float checkpoint is reconstructed losslessly from the exported QuantizedNetwork using FloatNetwork.from_quantized, round-tripped, and required to requantize to byte-identical NNUE payload bytes.
amendedContracts.healthMetricSubjectChange: Generation 1 applied the float-versus-quantized health limits to the raw straight-through optimizer shadow. Generation 2 applies the same numeric limits to the deployment-equivalent float checkpoint reconstructed from the exported network. This changes the artifact measured, not the thresholds or the deployed network.
amendedContracts.healthInput: The frozen 2 cp mean and 10 cp maximum float-versus-quantized health limits apply to the deployment-equivalent float checkpoint.
amendedContracts.manifest: Pin both checkpoints, the original optimizer-shadow manifest, the canonicalizing wrapper, and the exact byte-identical requantization proof.
amendedContracts.informationBoundary: Canonicalization reads network parameters and feature-only health inputs; it does not decode held-out targets.

forbiddenAlternatives: Do not delete or overwrite the optimizer shadow.
Do not lower the 2 cp mean or 10 cp maximum health limits.
Do not change K1/K2 recipes in this generation.
Do not inspect held-out labels before a winner hash is sealed.
Do not reuse generation 1 as a successful selection.
Do not train generation 2 on generation-1 positions or teacher labels.
Do not reuse a generation-1 screen or confirmation suite.
